subject: Missed bridge during discovery — propose two windows for deep dive / qualification checklist
messages:
From: Tom Henderson <t.henderson@stellarlabs.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aisha Kline <a.kline@stellarlabs.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick discovery follow-up

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Two quick things — we didn't get a calendar invite or a join link for the tech deep dive you mentioned during the call, and I'm double-checking that the time you proposed was in PDT (we're in PST). Aisha and I are happy to do a deeper technical session but want to confirm the link/time before blocking calendars.

Also, quick note on scope: we'll want to review prefix caching behavior, KMS integration, and a rough cost estimate for 10M tokens/month.

Can you resend the invite and confirm the timezone?

Best,
Tom
Director of Platform Engineering, Stellar Labs
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0143
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Henderson <t.henderson@stellarlabs.com>
Cc: Aisha Kline <a.kline@stellarlabs.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Missed bridge during discovery — propose two windows for deep dive / qualification checklist

Tom — thanks for the heads up and apologies for the confusion (and the missing invite). I dug into it and it looks like the calendar request we sent used a stale Meet link that Google rejected; that's on me.

To move quickly, proposing two windows that work for our SE (Aditya) and me:
- Tuesday 2026-07-07 10:00–11:00 PDT (UTC-7)
- Wednesday 2026-07-08 16:00–17:00 PDT (UTC-7)

If neither works, send two times that do and we'll prioritize. I created a fresh Google Meet link below and included a Calendly alternative if you prefer to pick a slot: https://meet.google.com/lookup/_redwood-deepdive-bridge (primary) • https://calendly.com/redwood-deepdive/60min (alt).

To make the deep dive efficient, could you confirm these three quick qualification items before the session?
1) Data residency: will Stellar Labs require on-prem or VPC-only deployment for this workload? (yes/no)
2) Volume: is 10M tokens/month a sustained baseline or a peak estimate? (sustained/peak)
3) Auth: are you expecting KMS/HSM-based customer-managed keys or are platform-managed keys acceptable for a POC? (CMK/platform)

Attached are the brief discovery notes from today's call and our SLA summary. Aditya — looping you in for the caching/quantization angles; please add any pre-reads we should send.

Thanks — will wait for a time confirmation and the answers above so we can prep the right demos and cost numbers.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
redwoodinference.com

Attachments: discovery-notes-20260705.pdf, redwood-sla-summary.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Henderson <t.henderson@stellarlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Kline <a.kline@stellarlabs.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 12:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Missed bridge during discovery — propose two windows for deep dive / qualification checklist

Adding a quick SE note so we can scope the deep dive:
- If Stellar Labs wants CMK/HSM for the POC, we'll need an internal tick on key exchange + a short runbook (15–30 min) in the session to validate KMS permissions.
- For prefix/KV caching: helpful to know typical request batch sizes and median sequence lengths; a sample payload or analytics excerpt (anonymized) is ideal but not mandatory.
- On quantization: if cost is a priority, we can show an LLM variant with 4-bit quantization and regression checks against your prompts.

If Sofia confirms Tuesday 10am PDT, I'll build a short demo plan and attach a 1-page pre-read. Otherwise, I can prep both slots.

–Aditya
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Kline <a.kline@stellarlabs.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Henderson <t.henderson@stellarlabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 11:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Missed bridge during discovery — propose two windows for deep dive / qualification checklist

Thanks — Tuesday 10:00 PDT works for us (Tom confirmed).

Quick answers to the checklist:
1) Data residency: For the POC, platform-managed keys are fine; we'll evaluate CMK for production.
2) Volume: 10M tokens/month is a conservative sustained baseline (not just peak).
3) Auth: POC: platform keys; Production: likely CMK/HSM.

We'll block the 10:00–11:00 PDT slot and expect the updated calendar invite/Meet link. Please include the short pre-read Aditya mentioned so our infra team can skim before the session.

See you Tuesday — appreciate the quick turnaround on the invite.

Best,
Aisha Kline
Engineering Manager, Stellar Labs
